headline: Nexus Venture Partners led a $45 million Series A for Hyphenate
body: Hyphenate, the autonomous finance platform for the office of the CFO, announced a $45 million Series A led by Nexus Venture Partners. Participation came from B Capital and existing investors including Foundation Capital, BoldCap and Gaia Ventures.
note: Hyphenate describes the shift as finance AI moving from helping teams work faster to taking responsibility for the work itself. That is the company's own framing.

evidence.text: The first wave of finance AI helped teams work faster. The next is taking responsibility for the work itself.

Hyphenate, the autonomous finance platform for the office of the CFO, today announced a $45 million Series A led by Nexus Venture Partners, with participation from B Capital and existing investors including Foundation Capital, BoldCap and Gaia Ventures.
